about: Probe S3 (C3): our block width and length at the start of each phase against the provider's, under eight fixed definitions; the chosen one, who fixes its ends and how much of it the camera saw. No outcome of any question: nothing after the phase's start frame. The rule is in the docstring of ac2fb.defence.probe_s3.

verdict.rule: C3 dies if the chosen definition of the block reproduces the provider's width and length (Pearson r >= min_r, median absolute difference <= max_median_diff_m, at least min_pairs phases) in fewer than min_reproduced matches
